purpose: Broad candidate inventory for anomaly-first hunting. Entries are leads whose confidence comes from context, relationships, rarity, and corroboration.
generation_notes: Curated entries and capability references are compiled into versioned runtime packs; generated packs are not independent sources of truth.
Source capability records identify published dual-use capabilities; they are not safe process-name-only alerts.
ATT&CK analytic details remain in the pinned local attack catalog and are referenced instead of duplicated.
Before promotion, every candidate needs a dataset-compatible predicate, explicit false-positive handling, and replay against representative benign and malicious telemetry.

prioritization_model.principle: Elevate concrete harmful behavior and independent corroboration; retain weak anomalies as context until they form a meaningful relationship.
downrank_factors: common signed binary without suspicious arguments
missing telemetry needed to establish the behavior
never_assume: tool name alone proves execution purpose
shared time or IP alone proves causality
